info.title: CardDemo API
info.description: REST replacement of the CardDemo CICS online transactions (sign-on, accounts, cards, transactions, reports, bill payment, pending authorizations, user and transaction-type administration) plus the rewards system. Every operation except POST /auth/login and POST /auth/logout needs a bearer token from POST /auth/login; every /admin operation needs the token of an admin user (usr_type A).

1400-SEND-SCREEN, COMMON-RETURN — P-COACTVWC-004 to P-COACTVWC-012,

get.description:
`GET /accounts/{id}` (CAVW): the account number `{id}` as entered, edited
and read by `account_view::view` (the card cross-reference through
`CXACAIX`, then the account, then the customer) in a unit of work that is
rolled back once the reads are done. The answer carries the account and
customer records, the account's first card number and the version token
`PUT /accounts/{id}` echoes back. A successful view shows no message
(P-COACTVWC-025).

# Errors

- 400 at `ACCTSID` when the number is blank, spaces or `*`
  (V-COACTVWC-001), or is not 11 digits or is zero (V-COACTVWC-002), a
  segment longer than its published 11-character `maxLength` included.
- 404 at `ACCTSID` when the cross-reference, the account or the customer
  is not on file (V-COACTVWC-003, V-COACTVWC-005, V-COACTVWC-007).
- 500 at `ACCTSID` with the file-error text when a read fails otherwise
  (V-COACTVWC-004, V-COACTVWC-006, V-COACTVWC-008), and 500 with
  [`messages::UNEXPECTED_ERROR`] when the database is unavailable.
- 401 from [`AuthUser`] for a request without a valid bearer token.

parameters.description: ACCT-ID 9(11) as entered

401.description: Missing, malformed, badly signed or expired bearer token

put.summary:
COACTUPC 0000-MAIN, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS /
9600-WRITE-PROCESSING — P-COACTUPC-003 to P-COACTUPC-015, P-COACTUPC-018
to P-COACTUPC-033, P-COACTUPC-043 to P-COACTUPC-045, P-COACTUPC-047 to
P-COACTUPC-050, V-COACTUPC-001 to V-COACTUPC-128
put.description:
`PUT /accounts/{id}` (CAUP): the fetch, the edits and the write of the
three `COACTUPC` turns in one request, in the order the validation audit
ranks their messages:

1. the BMS field lengths of the body and of the `{id}` segment
   (`ACCTSIDI X(11)`), then the body's `version` token (V-COACTUPC-001),
   before any COBOL edit and before the unit of work opens;
2. the account number `{id}` and the fetch, `load_snapshot`;
3. `account_update::validate` against the fetched records, with the
   processing clock's date as `FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE`: the comparison
   with the fetched values, then every `1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS` edit in
   COBOL order, the first failing edit supplying the message;
4. for a change that passed every edit, the locked reads, the change
   check and the two rewrites (`persist`).

Steps 1 to 3 write nothing, and their unit of work is rolled back. The
answer is 200 with the records as they now stand, their version token and
the text `COACTUPC` shows: [`messages::CHANGES_COMMITTED_TO_DATABASE`]
after both rewrites (P-COACTUPC-015), or
[`messages::NO_CHANGE_DETECTED_WITH_RESPECT_TO_VALUES_FETCHED`] when the
body repeats the fetched values (V-COACTUPC-010).

# Errors

- 400 with [`MISSING_VERSION_MESSAGE`] and no fields when `version` is
  missing or malformed (V-COACTUPC-001), and 400 with no message naming
  each body field longer than its BMS field and `ACCTSID` for an `{id}`
  segment longer than 11 characters, which `1210-EDIT-ACCOUNT` would
  otherwise see cut to the account its first 11 characters name.
- 400 at `ACCTSID` for a blank, non-numeric or zero account number
  (V-COACTUPC-002, V-COACTUPC-003), and 400 at the flagged fields for the
  first failing field edit (V-COACTUPC-011 to V-COACTUPC-123).
- 404 or 500 at `ACCTSID` when the fetch finds no record or a read fails
  (V-COACTUPC-004 to V-COACTUPC-009).
- 409 at `ACCTSID` with [`messages::RECORD_CHANGED_BY_SOME_ONE_ELSE`]
  when the locked records differ from the token's (V-COACTUPC-126).
- 500 at `ACCTSID` when a lock or a rewrite fails (V-COACTUPC-124,
  V-COACTUPC-125, V-COACTUPC-127, V-COACTUPC-128); after a failed customer
  rewrite the account rewrite stays committed (P-COACTUPC-014).
- 500 with [`messages::UNEXPECTED_ERROR`] for an input class held at
  `halt` (E-26, E-40, E-47, E-74), and when the database or the commit
  fails.
- 401 from [`AuthUser`] for a request without a valid bearer token.

get.summary:
`GET /admin/reward-rules`: every reward rule, active, future and
soft-deleted alike, in `rule_id` order (Request › Rewards system › Admin
endpoints, AAP 0.3.5).
get.description:
No rules is 200 with an empty list. A soft-deleted rule shows the
`active_to` its delete set.

# Errors

- 401 without a valid bearer token, 403 for a non-admin token.
- 500 `Unexpected error` when the read fails or a stored rule does not
  fit its domain type.

200.description: Every reward rule, active and soft-deleted, in `rule_id` order

403.description: The token is not an admin's

500.description: The rules could not be read

post.summary:
`POST /admin/reward-rules`: stores a new reward rule and answers 201 with
it, under the `rule_id` the database assigned (Request › Rewards system ›
Admin endpoints, AAP 0.3.5).
post.description:
# Errors

- 400 `INVALID` for a body that does not deserialize, or a field whose
  text does not convert to its type, with the rejection text and no
  `fields`.
- 400 `INVALID` from `validate_rule`, with one `fields` entry per failed
  check: `reward_rate` (`reward_rate must not be negative`),
  `min_transaction_amount` (`min_transaction_amount must not exceed
  max_transaction_amount`), `active_to` (`active_to must not precede
  active_from`). The message is the first failure's.
- 401 without a valid bearer token, 403 for a non-admin token.
- 500 `Unexpected error` when the insert or the commit fails.

400.description: The body does not convert, or a rule check failed

403.description: The token is not an admin's

500.description: The rule could not be stored

put.summary:
`PUT /admin/reward-rules/{id}`: replaces every column of the rule but its
`rule_id` and answers 200 with the rule as stored (Request › Rewards
system › Admin endpoints, AAP 0.3.5).
put.description:
The checks run in this order: the rule ID, the body's conversion, then
`validate_rule`; only then is the rule written.

# Errors

- 404 `NOT_FOUND` (`Reward rule not found`) when `{id}` is not an integer
  or names no rule.
- 400 `INVALID` for a body that does not deserialize or convert, or that
  fails a rule check, as for `POST /admin/reward-rules`.
- 401 without a valid bearer token, 403 for a non-admin token.
- 500 `Unexpected error` when the update or the commit fails.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The `rule_id` of the rule to replace

200.description: The rule as stored

400.description: The body does not convert, or a rule check failed

403.description: The token is not an admin's

404.description: No rule has the ID

500.description: The rule could not be stored

delete.summary:
`DELETE /admin/reward-rules/{id}`: soft-deletes the rule and answers 200
with it (Request › Rewards system › Admin endpoints, AAP 0.3.5).
delete.description:
The rule's `active_to` becomes the processing clock's instant when it is
absent or later; a rule that has already ended is answered unchanged. The
row is never removed, because accruals reference its `rule_id`.

# Errors

- 404 `NOT_FOUND` (`Reward rule not found`) when `{id}` is not an integer
  or names no rule.
- 401 without a valid bearer token, 403 for a non-admin token.
- 500 `Unexpected error` when the update, the read or the commit fails.

parameters.description: The `rule_id` of the rule to soft-delete

200.description: The rule after the soft delete, or unchanged when it had already ended

403.description: The token is not an admin's

404.description: No rule has the ID

500.description: The rule could not be soft-deleted

get.summary:
Lists the transaction types that pass the filters: one page from
`start_key` in `direction` (CTLI ENTER, F8 and F7).
get.description:
COTRTLIC 1200-EDIT-INPUTS, 1290-CROSS-EDITS, 8000-READ-FORWARD,
8100-READ-BACKWARDS, 2500-SETUP-MESSAGE — P-COTRTLIC-003, P-COTRTLIC-004,
P-COTRTLIC-022, P-COTRTLIC-030 to P-COTRTLIC-034, P-COTRTLIC-036,
V-COTRTLIC-001, V-COTRTLIC-002, V-COTRTLIC-004, V-COTRTLIC-005,
V-COTRTLIC-008, V-COTRTLIC-009, V-COTRTLIC-024, V-COTRTLIC-026,
V-COTRTLIC-028; 2600-SEND-SCREEN — P-COTRTLIC-029: the HTTP response
replaces the 3270 send of the `CTRTLIA` map, a mandated deviation.

A page holds `page_size` rows, seven (`WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES`) when absent,
in ascending type code order. Without `start_key` both directions read
the first page from the start of the table: backward is F7 on the first
page, which re-reads that page with `No previous pages to display`
(P-COTRTLIC-004, V-COTRTLIC-009). An empty result and a page boundary are
200 with the COBOL text in `message` (E-54).

# Errors

- 400 with an empty message for a filter longer than its BMS field, on
  `TRTYPE` or `TRDESC`, and for a `start_key` longer than two characters
  or not in ASCII, on no field; 400 for a malformed query; and 400 for a
  type code filter that is not two digits, on `TRTYPE` (V-COTRTLIC-001).
  The filters are checked first, then the start key, before the master
  is read.
- 401 without a valid token; 403 for a token that is not an admin's.
- 404 when no type passes the filters (V-COTRTLIC-002), a description
  filter holding a character outside ASCII included, which is searched as
  entered.
- 500 with the cursor's Db2 text when the read fails (V-COTRTLIC-024,
  V-COTRTLIC-026), with the no-records text when the filter count fails
  (V-COTRTLIC-028), and with `Unexpected error` when the database cannot
  be reached.

parameters.name: type_code
parameters.description:
The type code filter, `TRTYPE` `X(2)`: two digits, or blank or `00` for
every type.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description:
The description filter, `TRDESC` `X(50)`: the types whose description
contains this text, its leading and trailing spaces dropped.

parameters.name: start_key
parameters.description:
The type code the page starts from, `X(2)` in ASCII: a previous
page's `next_key` or `prev_key`. Forward (F8), the page starts at that
code, inclusive; backward (F7), it holds the types before it. Absent,
empty, all spaces or all low-values is no key: both directions read
the first page, backward with `No previous pages to display`.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: `forward` (ENTER and F8, the default) or `backward` (F7).

schema.description: The way a page request reads from `start_key`.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
Rows on the page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 7, the rows of the
`COTRTLI` screen.

200.description: One page of transaction types, with the page-boundary text in `message` where the COBOL shows one

400.description: A filter is longer than its field, the start key is longer than its field or not ASCII, the type code filter is not two digits, or the query is malformed

403.description: The token is not an admin's

404.description: No transaction type passes the filters

500.description: The Db2 master could not be read

post.summary:
Adds a transaction type: the `COTRTUP` F5 on a key not found, with the
edits of the new details (CTTU).
post.description:
COTRTUPC 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS, 9000-READ-TRANTYPE, 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING,
9700-INSERT-RECORD — P-COTRTUPC-006, P-COTRTUPC-007, P-COTRTUPC-009,
P-COTRTUPC-031, V-COTRTUPC-012 to V-COTRTUPC-021

The key is edited first, then read: a code already on file is refused.
The description is edited next, and the write updates first and inserts
on `SQLCODE` +100, as `9600-WRITE-PROCESSING` does. A stored type is
committed and answered 201 with `Changes committed to database`.

# Errors

- 400 for a member longer than its BMS field or a malformed body, and for
  the key and description edits, on `TRTYPCD` or `TRTYDSC`
  (V-COTRTUPC-012 to V-COTRTUPC-014, V-COTRTUPC-017, V-COTRTUPC-018).
- 401 without a valid token; 403 for a token that is not an admin's.
- 409 with no message when a type already has the code (V-COTRTUPC-015,
  E-51).
- 500 with the Db2 text when the read or the write fails (V-COTRTUPC-016,
  V-COTRTUPC-019 to V-COTRTUPC-021); nothing is written.

201.description: The type was added; `message` is the COBOL commit text

400.description: The type code or the description fails its edit

403.description: The token is not an admin's

409.description: A transaction type already has the code

500.description: The Db2 master could not be read or written

put.summary:
Updates the description of the type `{id}`: without `origin` the
`COTRTUP` maintenance screen (CTTU), with `origin=list` the inline update
of a listed row (CTLI).
put.description:
Without `origin`: COTRTUPC 9000-READ-TRANTYPE, 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS,
1205-COMPARE-OLD-NEW, 9600-WRITE-PROCESSING — P-COTRTUPC-007,
P-COTRTUPC-008, P-COTRTUPC-015 to P-COTRTUPC-021, V-COTRTUPC-001 to
V-COTRTUPC-011. A request that repeats the stored values writes nothing
and is 200 with `No change detected with respect to values fetched.`
(V-COTRTUPC-006); a change is committed with `Changes committed to
database`.

With `origin=list`: COTRTLIC 1211-EDIT-ARRAY-DESC, 1240-EDIT-ALPHANUM-REQD,
9200-UPDATE-RECORD — P-COTRTLIC-009, P-COTRTLIC-010, P-COTRTLIC-013,
P-COTRTLIC-017, P-COTRTLIC-021, V-COTRTLIC-012 to V-COTRTLIC-014,
V-COTRTLIC-016 to V-COTRTLIC-018. The update is committed with
`HIGHLIGHTED row was updated`, or with `No change detected with respect to
database values.` when only the case changed, which `COTRTLIC` still
writes (V-COTRTLIC-012, E-73). Either answer also carries `info`, the info
line `HIGHLIGHTED row was updated` that `9200-UPDATE-RECORD` sets once the
update is stored (P-COTRTLIC-009); without `origin` there is no `info`.

# Errors

- 400 for a key or description longer than its BMS field, a malformed
  query or body, and the key and description edits: on `TRTYPCD` or
  `TRTYDSC` without `origin` (V-COTRTUPC-001 to V-COTRTUPC-003,
  V-COTRTUPC-007, V-COTRTUPC-008), on no field with `origin=list`
  (V-COTRTLIC-013, V-COTRTLIC-014), where a key holding a character
  outside ASCII is also refused with an empty message. A description
  holding one gets the alphanumeric edit's text with either origin.
- 401 without a valid token; 403 for a token that is not an admin's.
- 404 when no type has the code (V-COTRTUPC-004, V-COTRTLIC-016).
- 500 with the Db2 or lock text when the read or the update fails
  (V-COTRTUPC-005, V-COTRTUPC-009 to V-COTRTUPC-011, V-COTRTLIC-017,
  V-COTRTLIC-018); nothing is written.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The type code, `TR_TYPE`: two ASCII characters

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description:
`list` for the inline update of the type list (`COTRTLIC`); absent for
the maintenance screen (`COTRTUPC`).

schema.description:
The program whose edits and texts `PUT /admin/transaction-types/{id}`
applies.

200.description: The description was stored, or nothing changed; `message` is the COBOL text, and with `origin=list` `info` is the COTRTLIC info line

400.description: The type code or the description fails its edit

403.description: The token is not an admin's

404.description: No transaction type has the code

500.description: The Db2 master could not be read or updated

delete.summary:
Deletes the listed type `{id}`: the `D` selector of the `COTRTLI` list,
confirmed with F10 (CTLI).
delete.description:
COTRTLIC 9300-DELETE-RECORD — P-COTRTLIC-007, P-COTRTLIC-008,
V-COTRTLIC-021 to V-COTRTLIC-023

The confirmation is the dialog of the SPA. A deleted type is committed
and answered with `HIGHLIGHTED row deleted.Hit Enter to continue` and no
type.

# Errors

- 400 for a key longer than the type code `X(2)` or holding a character
  outside ASCII, or a malformed path.
- 401 without a valid token; 403 for a token that is not an admin's.
- 404 with the delete-failed Db2 text when no type has the code
  (V-COTRTLIC-022).
- 409 with the child-records Db2 text when categories still reference the
  type (SQLCODE -532, V-COTRTLIC-021); the type stays.
- 500 with the delete-failed Db2 text on any other failure
  (V-COTRTLIC-023).

parameters.description: The type code, `TR_TYPE`: two ASCII characters

200.description: The type was deleted; `message` is the COBOL text and `transaction_type` is null

400.description: The type code is longer than two characters or not ASCII

403.description: The token is not an admin's

404.description: No transaction type has the code

409.description: Transaction categories still reference the type

500.description: The Db2 master could not be updated

get.summary: CU00: one page of the user list, in user-ID order.
get.description:
COUSR00C PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, PROCESS-PF7-KEY, PROCESS-PF8-KEY,
PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD, PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD — P-COUSR00C-003 to
P-COUSR00C-011; V-COUSR00C-002 to V-COUSR00C-009 (E-54, E-71).
COUSR00C SEND-USRLST-SCREEN — P-COUSR00C-013: the 200 page, its
`message` included, replaces the `COUSR0A` map.

`start_key` is the `USRIDIN` search field and the page keys a previous
page returned; `direction=forward` is ENTER and PF8, `direction=backward`
PF7; `page_size` defaults to the 10 rows of the `COUSR0A` screen. A
page-boundary text, which `COUSR00C` shows without its error flag, comes
back in `message` of the 200 page, and a start key with no user at or
after it is an empty page with `You are at the top of the page...`. Each
row is the user's ID, names and type; `SEC-USR-PWD` is never listed.

# Errors

- 400 `INVALID`, field `USRIDIN`, for a start key longer than `PIC X(8)`,
  holding a character outside ASCII, or holding a NUL character without
  being the 8 of `LOW-VALUES` (E-49), and for a query that does not
  deserialize (a `page_size` outside 1 to 100, an unknown `direction`).
- 401 without a valid bearer token; 403 for a token that is not an
  administrator's.
- 500 `Unable to lookup User...`, field `USRIDIN`, when the user browse
  fails (V-COUSR00C-004, V-COUSR00C-006, V-COUSR00C-009).

parameters.name: start_key
parameters.description:
The user ID the page starts from, `USRIDINI` `X(8)` in ASCII without
NUL characters, case kept, or exactly 8 NUL characters, the
`LOW-VALUES` of the top of the file: the search field, or a key a page
returned. Forward, the page starts at the first user ID at or after
it; backward, it holds the users before that one. Absent, empty, all
spaces or the 8 low-values is the top of the file: the first page
forward, and backward an empty page with
`You are already at the top of the page...`.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: `forward` (ENTER and PF8, the default) or `backward` (PF7).

schema.description: The way a page request reads from `start_key`.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
Rows on the page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10, the rows of the
`COUSR0A` screen.

200.description: The page of users, with the page-boundary text COUSR00C shows, if any

400.description: A start key longer than 8 characters, not ASCII, or holding a NUL character other than the 8 of LOW-VALUES, or a malformed query

403.description: The token is not an administrator's

500.description: The user browse failed

post.description:
COUSR01C PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, WRITE-USER-SEC-FILE — P-COUSR01C-002 to
P-COUSR01C-005; V-COUSR01C-001 to V-COUSR01C-007 (E-20).
COUSR01C SEND-USRADD-SCREEN — P-COUSR01C-007: the response body and the
form's field errors replace the `COUSR1A` map.

The five fields are edited for emptiness in screen order (first name, last
name, user ID, password, user type) and stored exactly as entered: no
upper-casing, no user-type check. The password is stored as the argon2id
hash of its 8 space-padded bytes, so a user ID or password added in lower
or mixed case never signs on, as in the COBOL (E-20). The 201 body carries
the user as written and `User <id> has been added ...`.

# Errors

- 400 `EMPTY` with the empty-field message of the first blank field
  (`FNAME`, `LNAME`, `USERID`, `PASSWD`, `USRTYPE`), or 400 `INVALID` for a
  field longer than its BMS field or holding a character outside ASCII,
  or a body that does not deserialize.
- 401 without a valid bearer token; 403 for a token that is not an
  administrator's.
- 409 `User ID already exist...`, field `USERID` (V-COUSR01C-006).
- 500 `Unable to Add User...`, field `FNAME`, when the write fails or the
  password cannot be hashed (V-COUSR01C-007).

400.description: A blank, over-length or non-ASCII field, or a malformed body

403.description: The token is not an administrator's

500.description: The user could not be added

get.summary:
CU02 and CU03 ENTER: fetches one user for the edit form or the delete
dialog.
get.description:
COUSR02C PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, READ-USER-SEC-FILE — P-COUSR02C-002,
P-COUSR02C-003, P-COUSR02C-007; V-COUSR02C-001 to V-COUSR02C-003, and the
identical `COUSR03C` fetch rows V-COUSR03C-001 to V-COUSR03C-003 (E-21,
E-58).
COUSR02C SEND-USRUPD-SCREEN — P-COUSR02C-009: the response body replaces
the `COUSR2A` map.
COUSR03C SEND-USRDEL-SCREEN — P-COUSR03C-007: the delete dialog, filled
from the response body, replaces the `COUSR3A` map.

The body is the user's ID, names and type. `COUSR02C` also moves the
stored password into its edit field; a stored argon2id hash cannot be
shown, so no password is ever returned (E-21, a known difference).

# Errors

- 400 `EMPTY` `User ID can NOT be empty...`, field `USRIDIN`, for a blank
  ID, or 400 `INVALID` for an ID longer than `PIC X(8)` or holding a
  character outside ASCII.
- 401 without a valid bearer token; 403 for a token that is not an
  administrator's.
- 404 `User ID NOT found...`, field `USRIDIN` (V-COUSR02C-002).
- 500 `Unable to lookup User...`, field `FNAME`, when the read fails
  (V-COUSR02C-003).

put.summary: CU02 PF5: updates a user's names, password and type.
put.description:
COUSR02C UPDATE-USER-INFO, READ-USER-SEC-FILE, UPDATE-USER-SEC-FILE —
P-COUSR02C-004 to P-COUSR02C-007; V-COUSR02C-004 to V-COUSR02C-012 (E-21,
E-46).
COUSR02C SEND-USRUPD-SCREEN — P-COUSR02C-009: the response body replaces
the `COUSR2A` map.

The fields are edited for emptiness in screen order (user ID, first name,
last name, password, user type); the user is then read for update and
each entered field compared with the stored value. An absent `password`
stands for the current one: unchanged and never re-hashed. A present one
is compared by argon2 verification, case kept, and re-hashed when it
differs (E-21). When a field differs the record is rewritten and the body
carries `User <id> has been updated ...`. When none does, nothing is
written and the answer is still 200, with `Please modify to update ...`:
`COUSR02C` sets that text without its error flag (V-COUSR02C-010).

# Errors

- 400 `EMPTY` with the empty-field message of the first blank field
  (`USRIDIN`, `FNAME`, `LNAME`, `PASSWD`, `USRTYPE`), or 400 `INVALID` for
  a field or ID longer than its BMS field or holding a character outside
  ASCII, or a body that does not deserialize.
- 401 without a valid bearer token; 403 for a token that is not an
  administrator's.
- 404 `User ID NOT found...`, field `USRIDIN`, when the rewrite finds no
  user (V-COUSR02C-011).
- 500 `Unable to Update User...`, field `FNAME`, for an unknown user, whose
  failed read the COBOL follows with a failing rewrite (V-COUSR02C-009,
  E-46), for a failed rewrite (V-COUSR02C-012), and when the password
  cannot be verified or hashed. Nothing is written on any error.

parameters.description: The user ID, `SEC-USR-ID` `X(08)`, as stored (case kept): at most 8 ASCII characters

200.description: The user was updated, or no field differed and nothing was written

400.description: A blank, over-length or non-ASCII field or user ID, or a malformed body

403.description: The token is not an administrator's

404.description: The rewrite found no user

`DELETE` response replace the `COUSR3A` map.

The user is read for update and deleted. The body carries the user as
read before the delete and `User <id> has been deleted ...`.

# Errors

- 400 `EMPTY` `User ID can NOT be empty...`, field `USRIDIN`, for a blank
  ID, or 400 `INVALID` for an ID longer than `PIC X(8)` or holding a
  character outside ASCII.
- 401 without a valid bearer token; 403 for a token that is not an
  administrator's.
- 404 `User ID NOT found...`, field `USRIDIN`, when the delete finds no
  user after the read found it (V-COUSR03C-006).
- 500 `Unable to Update User...`, field `FNAME` (the COBOL's own text,
  reproduced): for an unknown user, whose failed read the COBOL follows
  with a failing delete (V-COUSR03C-005, E-46), and for a failed delete
  (V-COUSR03C-007). Nothing is deleted on any error.

COSGN00C PROCESS-ENTER-KEY / READ-USER-SEC-FILE — P-COSGN00C-002,
P-COSGN00C-005, P-COSGN00C-006, P-COSGN00C-007, P-COSGN00C-008,
P-COSGN00C-009, P-COSGN00C-010, P-COSGN00C-011, P-COSGN00C-012,
P-COSGN00C-013, P-COSGN00C-015, V-COSGN00C-001, V-COSGN00C-002,
V-COSGN00C-003, V-COSGN00C-004, V-COSGN00C-005.
post.description:
`POST /auth/login`: signs the user on with the `COSGN00C` rules and issues
the bearer token. The user ID and password are upper-cased and padded to 8
before the user is read and the password verified, so `admin001` and
`password` sign on as `ADMIN001`, while a user ID or password stored in
lower or mixed case never signs on (E-20).

Answers 200, not 201: sign-on writes nothing.

# Errors

The error body `{code, message, fields}`, with the audited `COSGN00C`
message and the BMS field the COBOL puts the cursor on:

- 400: a field longer than its 8-character map field, with an empty
  message (`USERID`, `PASSWD`); 'Please enter User ID ...' (`USERID`,
  V-COSGN00C-001); 'Please enter Password ...' (`PASSWD`, V-COSGN00C-002).
  The user ID is edited first.
- 401: 'User not found. Try again ...' (`USERID`, V-COSGN00C-003); 'Wrong
  Password. Try again ...' (`PASSWD`, V-COSGN00C-005).
- 500: 'Unable to verify the User ...' (`USERID`, V-COSGN00C-004) when the
  user read fails or the stored hash is unusable; 'Unexpected error' when
  the database transaction cannot be opened or ended, the verification
  task fails, or the token cannot be signed.

200.description: Signed on: the bearer token and the landing route

400.description: A blank or over-length user ID or password

401.description: Unknown user ID or wrong password

500.description: The user could not be verified

post.description:
`POST /auth/logout`: PF3 on the sign-on screen, answered with the
`CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU` text of `CSMSG01Y` byte for byte, trailing spaces
included [app/cpy/CSMSG01Y.cpy:L18-19]. Public and stateless: no token is
read and no session ends, because none exists on the server; the SPA
discards its token and shows `/login`.

get.summary:
COPAUS0C GATHER-DETAILS, PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, PROCESS-PF7-KEY,
PROCESS-PF8-KEY — P-COPAUS0C-001, P-COPAUS0C-003, P-COPAUS0C-006 to
P-COPAUS0C-015, P-COPAUS0C-020, V-COPAUS0C-001, V-COPAUS0C-002,
V-COPAUS0C-004 to V-COPAUS0C-015: the pending authorizations of an account.
get.description:
The account ID is edited as entered, then the card cross-reference, the
account, the customer and the authorization summary of the account are
read, and, when the summary exists, one page of its authorizations, newest
first. Without `start_key` the page is the first one forward (ENTER) and
the last one, the oldest authorizations, backward; `next_key` with
`direction=forward` is PF8 and `prev_key` with `direction=backward` is
PF7. A request past either end lists nothing and carries the top- or
bottom-of-page text.

# Errors

- 400 with `Please enter Acct Id...` or `Acct Id must be Numeric ...` on
  `ACCTID` for a blank or non-numeric account ID, and 400 with code
  `INVALID` for a `start_key` that is not an authorization identity or a
  `page_size` outside 1 to 100.
- 401 without a valid bearer token.
- 404 with the `COPAUS0C` text when the account has no cross-reference,
  or the cross-reference names no account or customer.
- 500 with the `COPAUS0C` system-error text when a read fails or the
  authorization store cannot be opened.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description:
The account ID as entered, 11 digits (`ACCTIDI PIC X(11)`). Sent to
the rule unedited, so a blank or non-numeric value is answered with
the `COPAUS0C` message.

parameters.name: start_key
parameters.description:
The `auth_id` the page continues from, a previous page's `next_key` or
`prev_key`: forward (PF8) the last authorization shown, which the page
skips; backward (PF7) the first one shown, before which the page ends.
Absent, the page is the first one, the newest authorizations, forward
(ENTER), and the last one, the oldest, backward. A decimal integer
from -9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807, with an optional
sign and leading zeros.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: `forward` (next page, the default) or `backward` (previous page).

schema.description: The way a page request reads from `start_key`.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
Rows on the page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to the 5 rows of the
`COPAU00` list.

200.description: The account header, its authorization summary and one page of its pending authorizations, newest first

400.description: The account ID is blank or not 11 digits, or the page position is malformed

404.description: The account has no card cross-reference, or the cross-reference names no account or customer

get.summary:
COPAUS1C PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, READ-AUTH-RECORD, POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS,
PROCESS-PF8-KEY, READ-NEXT-AUTH-RECORD — P-COPAUS1C-003 to P-COPAUS1C-005,
P-COPAUS1C-009, P-COPAUS1C-014 to P-COPAUS1C-016, V-COPAUS1C-001 to
V-COPAUS1C-006, V-COPAUS1C-012, V-COPAUS1C-013: one pending authorization.
get.description:
The authorization summary of the detail's account is read, then the
detail by its `auth_id` (ENTER), then the PF8 read under the same summary
gives `next_id`, the next older authorization. At the last authorization
`next_id` is `null` and `message` carries
`Already at the last Authorization...`.

# Errors

Each on `CARDNUM`:

- 400 with no message when `{id}` is not a positive integer, the COBOL
  path with no selected key (V-COPAUS1C-001, E-49).
- 401 without a valid bearer token.
- 404 with no message when no authorization has the identity or no
  summary is found over it (V-COPAUS1C-004, V-COPAUS1C-005).
- 500 with ` System error while reading Auth Details: Code:` and the IMS
  status when the detail read fails, whatever the summary read answered
  (V-COPAUS1C-006); with ` System error while reading Auth Summary: Code:`
  and the IMS status when only the summary read fails (V-COPAUS1C-003);
  with ` System error while reading next Auth: Code:` when the next read
  fails (V-COPAUS1C-013); with the scheduling text when the authorization
  store cannot be opened (V-COPAUS1C-002).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
The authorization's `auth_id`, as a summary page lists it: a positive
integer up to 9223372036854775807, with an optional `+` and leading
zeros.

200.description: The authorization as the detail screen shows it, with the identity of the next one

400.description: The identity is not a positive integer

404.description: No authorization has the identity

500.description: A read failed or the authorization store could not be opened

put.summary:
COPAUS1C MARK-AUTH-FRAUD, READ-AUTH-RECORD, UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS,
TAKE-SYNCPOINT, ROLL-BACK with COPAUS2C — P-COPAUS1C-003, P-COPAUS1C-004,
P-COPAUS1C-006 to P-COPAUS1C-008, P-COPAUS1C-015, P-COPAUS1C-016,
P-COPAUS2C-001 to P-COPAUS2C-006, V-COPAUS1C-002 to V-COPAUS1C-007,
V-COPAUS1C-009 to V-COPAUS1C-011: PF5, the fraud mark of one pending
authorization.
put.description:
The request has no body: PF5 acts on the record shown. The authorization
summary of the detail's account is read, then the detail, under a row
lock held until the request commits or rolls back, so overlapping marks
of one authorization take turns and each toggles the flag the one before
it left. A detail holding `F` becomes `R` and its fraud report is removed;
any other detail becomes `F` and fraud is reported. `COPAUS2C` stamps the
report date of the processing clock and inserts the `AUTHFRDS` row, or
updates it when the authorization was reported before; then the detail is
replaced. Both writes commit together, and the response carries the
replaced detail with `AUTH MARKED FRAUD...` or `AUTH FRAUD REMOVED...`.

# Errors

Each on `CARDNUM`, and nothing is written:

- 400 with no message when `{id}` is not a positive integer.
- 401 without a valid bearer token.
- 404 with no message when no authorization has the identity or no
  summary is found over it, the outcome E-53 proposes for a fraud mark
  whose read finds nothing, or when the authorization's account has no
  card cross-reference to name its customer.
- 500 with ` System error while reading Auth Details: Code:` and the IMS
  status when the detail read fails or its lock cannot be taken, whatever
  the summary read answered (V-COPAUS1C-006); with
  ` System error while reading Auth Summary: Code:` and the IMS status
  when only the summary read fails (V-COPAUS1C-003); with the `COPAUS1C`
  or `COPAUS2C` text when the fraud-table write or the detail replace
  fails, or the scheduling text when the authorization store cannot be
  opened; 500 `Unexpected error` when the cross-reference read or the
  commit fails.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
The authorization's `auth_id`, as a summary page lists it: a positive
integer up to 9223372036854775807, with an optional `+` and leading
zeros.

200.description: The fraud mark was toggled: the replaced authorization and the text of the new mark

400.description: The identity is not a positive integer

404.description: No authorization has the identity, or its account has no card cross-reference

500.description: A read or write failed and nothing was changed

get.summary:
COCRDLIC 0000-MAIN, 2200-EDIT-INPUTS, 9000-READ-FORWARD,
9100-READ-BACKWARDS, 9500-FILTER-RECORDS, 1000-SEND-MAP,
1400-SETUP-MESSAGE, 1500-SEND-SCREEN — P-COCRDLIC-003 to P-COCRDLIC-006,
P-COCRDLIC-011 to P-COCRDLIC-015, P-COCRDLIC-017, P-COCRDLIC-020,
P-COCRDLIC-021, P-COCRDLIC-023, V-COCRDLIC-001, V-COCRDLIC-002,
V-COCRDLIC-005 to V-COCRDLIC-010
get.description:
One page of the card list in `CARDDAT` key order: forward (ENTER, PF8)
from `start_key` inclusively, or backward (PF7) from the first card of the
page shown, `WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES` (7) rows unless `page_size` says
otherwise. Without `start_key` both directions read the first page from
the lowest card number: backward is PF7 on the first entry, which re-reads
that page with 'NO PREVIOUS PAGES TO DISPLAY'
[app/cbl/COCRDLIC.cbl:L439-454]. Because PF7 stays live on the first
page, every non-empty page, the first included, carries its first card as
`prev_key`, and the backward request from the first page's `prev_key`
answers as that PF7 does (E-54); an empty page read from a `start_key`
carries that key. The `account_id` and `card_number` filters reach the
rule as entered, so a filter that is neither blank nor a number of its
width is answered with the `2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT` or `2220-EDIT-CARD` text.
An empty page is a page: 200 with `items: []` and the text the COBOL shows
with it.

# Errors

- 400 with an empty `message` when a filter is longer than its map field.
- 400 with 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER' at
  `ACCTSID` or 'CARD ID FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 16 DIGIT NUMBER' at
  `CARDSID` (V-COCRDLIC-001, V-COCRDLIC-002).
- 400 with code `INVALID` when the page parameters do not deserialize,
  and with code `INVALID`, an empty `message` and no field when
  `start_key` is longer than the 16 characters of a card number, holds a
  character outside ASCII or holds a NUL character, none of which a card
  number holds; no card is read.
- 401 without a valid bearer token.
- 500 with the `CARDDAT` file-error text at `ACCTSID` when a card read
  fails (V-COCRDLIC-008, V-COCRDLIC-010), or 'Unexpected error' when the
  database cannot be reached.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description:
The account filter, `ACCTSIDI X(11)`: 11 digits, or blank or all zeros
for no filter (`2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT`).

parameters.name: card_number
parameters.description:
The card filter, `CARDSIDI X(16)`: 16 digits, or blank or all zeros
for no filter (`2220-EDIT-CARD`).

parameters.name: start_key
parameters.description:
The card number the page starts from, `CARD-NUM` `X(16)` in ASCII
without NUL characters: a previous page's `next_key` or `prev_key`.
Forward (ENTER, PF8), the page starts at that card, inclusive;
backward (PF7), it holds the cards before it. Absent, both directions
read the first page.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: `forward` (ENTER and PF8, the default) or `backward` (PF7).

schema.description: The way a page request reads from `start_key`.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
Rows on the page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 7, the rows of the
`COCRDLI` screen.

200.description: One page of cards in card-number order, with the keys of its neighbours and the COBOL page text

400.description: A filter or page parameter the COBOL edits reject, or a start key longer than 16 characters, not ASCII or holding a NUL character

500.description: The card file could not be read

get.summary:

1400-SEND-SCREEN, COMMON-RETURN — P-COCRDSLC-002 to P-COCRDSLC-007,
P-COCRDSLC-010, P-COCRDSLC-012 to P-COCRDSLC-016, V-COCRDSLC-001 to

The card whose number is the `{id}` path segment, with the account number
of the `account_id` query parameter: both keys are edited as
`2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT` and `2220-EDIT-CARD` edit them, an absent account
being a blank one, and the card is then read by its number alone (E-55).
The response carries the card's version token, which a following
`PUT /cards/{id}` sends back, and never the verification code.

# Errors

- 400 with an empty `message` when `account_id` is longer than 11
  characters.
- 400 with 'Account number not provided', 'Card number not provided',
  'No input received', or the account or card not-numeric text, at
  `ACCTSID` or `CARDSID` (V-COCRDSLC-001 to V-COCRDSLC-005).
- 401 without a valid bearer token.
- 404 with 'Did not find cards for this search condition' at `ACCTSID`
  when no card has the number (V-COCRDSLC-006).
- 500 with the `CARDDAT` file-error text at `ACCTSID` when the read fails
  (V-COCRDSLC-007), or 'Unexpected error' when the database cannot be
  reached.

parameters.name: account_id

The account number, `ACCTSIDI X(11)`: 11 digits. Absent is a blank
account, which `2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT` answers 'Account number not
provided'. The card is read by its number alone, whatever account is
entered (E-55).

200.description: The card with its version token

400.description: A key the COBOL edits reject

404.description: No card has the number

500.description: The card file could not be read

put.summary:
COCRDUPC 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS, 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, 9000-READ-DATA,
9200-WRITE-PROCESSING, 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC, 3000-SEND-MAP,
3250-SETUP-INFOMSG, 3400-SEND-SCREEN, COMMON-RETURN — P-COCRDUPC-002 to
P-COCRDUPC-008, P-COCRDUPC-010 to P-COCRDUPC-017, P-COCRDUPC-019,
P-COCRDUPC-021 to P-COCRDUPC-023, P-COCRDUPC-028, V-COCRDUPC-001 to
V-COCRDUPC-020
put.description:
Updates the card whose number is the `{id}` path segment from the body's
map fields, in one request: the key edits, the fetch, the comparison with
the fetched card and the name, status, expiry month and year edits, then
the locked read, the change check against the body's `version` and the
rewrite. 200 on success, with 'Changes committed to database' after a
rewrite or 'No change detected with respect to values fetched.' when the
body changes nothing, and the card as it now stands with its new token.
`version` stands for the `CCUP-OLD-DETAILS` copy that `COMMON-RETURN`
keeps in the COMMAREA (E-24).

# Errors

- 400 with an empty `message` and no field when `version` is absent or is
  not 16 lower-case hex digits (V-COCRDUPC-001, E-24), or with an empty
  `message` and the BMS fields of the values longer than their map
  fields.
- 400 with the key edit texts at `ACCTSID` or `CARDSID`
  (V-COCRDUPC-002 to V-COCRDUPC-006) or the card-field edit texts at
  `CRDNAME`, `CRDSTCD`, `EXPMON` or `EXPYEAR` (V-COCRDUPC-010 to
  V-COCRDUPC-017), the first in COBOL order.
- 400 with code `INVALID` when the body is not a JSON object of strings.
- 401 without a valid bearer token.
- 404 with 'Did not find cards for this search condition' at `ACCTSID`
  (V-COCRDUPC-007).
- 409 with 'Record changed by some one else. Please review' at `CRDNAME`
  when the card changed since `version` was issued (V-COCRDUPC-019).
- 500 with the `CARDDAT` file-error text (V-COCRDUPC-008), 'Could not lock
  record for update' (V-COCRDUPC-018) or 'Update of record failed'
  (V-COCRDUPC-020) at `ACCTSID`, or 'Unexpected error' when the database
  cannot be reached or the commit fails.

CORPT00C PROCESS-ENTER-KEY / SUBMIT-JOB-TO-INTRDR — P-CORPT00C-002 to
P-CORPT00C-012, P-CORPT00C-014, P-CORPT00C-017, V-CORPT00C-001 to
V-CORPT00C-018; CBTRN03C 1000-TRANFILE-GET-NEXT /
1100-WRITE-TRANSACTION-REPORT — P-CBTRN03C-002 to P-CBTRN03C-015,
P-TRANREPT-002, P-TRANREPT-003
get.description:
Prints the transaction report of the requested range: the current month
(`monthly`), the current year (`yearly`) or `start_date` to `end_date`
(`custom`), once `confirm` is `Y`. The answer carries the `CVTRA07Y` report
records `CBTRN03C` writes for that range, untrimmed and in order, and the
`<name> report submitted for printing ...` message.

# Errors

- 400 with the audited `CORPT00C` message and its BMS field when an edit
  fails or the request is not confirmed: no report type, an empty or
  invalid custom date part, a date `CSUTLDTC` rejects, a blank, `N` or
  other confirmation (V-CORPT00C-001 to V-CORPT00C-018).
- 400 with no message, before those edits, when a query value is longer
  than its field (on `SDTYYYY`, `EDTYYYY` or `CONFIRM`) or the confirmation
  holds a character above `U+007F` (on `CONFIRM`).
- 401 without a valid bearer token.
- 500 `Unexpected error` when the database fails, when a report record's
  cross-reference, type or category is missing from `card_xref`,
  `trantype_file` or `trancatg_file` (the `CBTRN03C` abend, P-CBTRN03C-005),
  or when the outcome is one the audit holds at halt.

parameters.name: report_type
parameters.description:
The report to print: `monthly`, `yearly` or `custom`. Absent or blank
is no selection, answered with `Select a report type to print
report...` (V-CORPT00C-001).

schema.description:
The report selector of the map: `MONTHLYI`, `YEARLYI` and `CUSTOMI`, each
`X(1)` [app/cpy-bms/CORPT00.CPY:L60-72], become one value naming the
selector entered (E-48).

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description:
The custom start date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: year, month and day as entered in
`SDTYYYY`, `SDTMM` and `SDTDD`, an empty part standing for a blank
field (V-CORPT00C-002 to V-CORPT00C-004, V-CORPT00C-008 to
V-CORPT00C-010, V-CORPT00C-014). Read only for a custom report.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description:
The custom end date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: `EDTYYYY`, `EDTMM` and `EDTDD`
(V-CORPT00C-005 to V-CORPT00C-007, V-CORPT00C-011 to V-CORPT00C-013,
V-CORPT00C-015). Read only for a custom report.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description:
`CONFIRM X(1)` in ASCII: `Y` or `y` runs the report, which the SPA
confirmation dialog sends; absent or blank asks for confirmation

COTRN00C PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, PROCESS-PF7-KEY, PROCESS-PF8-KEY,
PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD/BACKWARD, SEND-TRNLST-SCREEN — P-COTRN00C-005 to
P-COTRN00C-016, P-COTRN00C-018; V-COTRN00C-001 to V-COTRN00C-013.
get.description:
One page of the live transaction master in TRAN-ID order: `direction`
`forward` is ENTER (and PF8 from the `next_key` of the previous page),
`backward` is PF7 from the first key shown, or the end of the file when no
`start_key` is given. `page_size` defaults to the 10 rows of the screen.
The page-boundary texts the COBOL sends without its error flag come back in
`message` of the 200 page; an empty master is a page without items.

# Errors

- 400 for an `account_id` filter that is not 11 digits (V-COTRN00C-001)
  or a `start_key` that is not 16 digits (V-COTRN00C-004), and for a query
  that does not deserialize, such as a `page_size` outside 1 to 100.
- 401 without a valid bearer token.
- 500 when the browse fails (V-COTRN00C-006, V-COTRN00C-008,
  V-COTRN00C-011, V-COTRN00C-013) or no unit of work can be opened.

account: 11 digits. Blank or absent lists every transaction.

page forward; what an absent key reads backward is the list's own, as

post.description:
Adds a transaction to the live master in one database transaction: the
`COTRN02C` edits in the COBOL order (key fields with their cross-reference
read, data fields with the `CSUTLDTC` date checks, then the `Y`/`N`
confirmation), the highest live TRAN-ID plus one, the record write, and the
reward accrual of the new transaction under the processing clock. A 201
carries the transaction and the `COTRN02C` success text.

Every `COTRN02C` outcome other than the add sets `WS-ERR-FLG`, the `N` and
blank confirmations included, so each is an error status and nothing is
written.

# Errors

- 400 for a member longer than its map field, a failed field edit or an
  unconfirmed add (V-COTRN02C-001 to V-COTRN02C-003, V-COTRN02C-008 to
  V-COTRN02C-028).
- 401 without a valid bearer token.
- 404 for an account or card without a cross-reference (V-COTRN02C-004,
  V-COTRN02C-006), and for an add against an empty live master
  (V-COTRN02C-029, E-27).
- 409 when the allocated TRAN-ID is already live (V-COTRN02C-032).
- 500 when a cross-reference read, the TRAN-ID allocation or the write
  fails (V-COTRN02C-005, V-COTRN02C-007, V-COTRN02C-030, V-COTRN02C-031,
  V-COTRN02C-033), and when the reward accrual or the commit fails or no
  unit of work can be opened. A failure after validation rolls back the
  insert, the accrual and the balance update together.

201.description: The transaction was added, with its reward accrual

400.description: Over-length member, failed field edit or unconfirmed add

404.description: No cross-reference for the account or card, or an empty transaction master

409.description: The allocated Tran ID is already live

500.description: A read, the allocation, the write, the reward accrual or the commit failed; nothing was persisted

V-COTRN01C-003.

- 400 for a blank Tran ID (V-COTRN01C-001).
- 401 without a valid bearer token.
- 404 when no live transaction has the Tran ID, every Tran ID after
  `batch tranbkp` included (V-COTRN01C-002).
- 500 when the read fails (V-COTRN01C-003) or no unit of work can be
  opened.

AccountResponse.description:
The account `GET /accounts/{id}` shows (CAVW), and the record part of the
`PUT /accounts/{id}` answer.

`COACTVWC` `1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS` [app/cbl/COACTVWC.cbl:L466-522]
(P-COACTVWC-014, P-COACTVWC-015) moves these fields, in this order, to the
`COACTVW` map; the `ACCT-ADDR-ZIP` of the account record is not shown and
not sent. Text fields are right-trimmed, `9(n)` fields are their
zero-padded digits and amounts are scale-2 decimal strings.

card_number.description:
`XREF-CARD-NUM X(16)` of the `CXACAIX` record the customer was found
through (P-COACTVWC-007): the account's first card, for navigation to
the card screens. No map field shows it.

cust_addr_line_3.description: `ACSCITY`: `CUST-ADDR-LINE-3 X(50)`, which the map shows as the city.

cust_ssn.description:
`ACSTSSN`: `CUST-SSN 9(09)`, 9 digits; the map shows them as
`999-99-9999`.

version.description:
The token `PUT /accounts/{id}` echoes back: 16 lower-case hex digits
standing for the fields `9700-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC` compares
(V-COACTUPC-126).

AccountUpdateField.description:
A BMS field the errors of `PUT /accounts/{id}` name: the `COACTUP` map
[app/cpy-bms/COACTUP.CPY], in map order.

Each variant is either a distinct `BMS field` of the `COACTUPC` rows of the
validation audit or one of the four input fields no edit checks
(`AADDGRP`, `ACSTNUM`, `ACSADL2`, `ACSGOVT`), which only
[`AccountUpdateRequest::check`] reports.

AccountUpdateRequest.description:
The body of `PUT /accounts/{id}` (CAUP): the `COACTUP` input fields
`1100-RECEIVE-MAP` receives into `ACUP-NEW-DETAILS`
[app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:L757-860], in map order, each as entered.

The account number is the `{id}` path segment (`ACCTSID`, 11 characters),
not a body field; [`AccountUpdateRequest::check`] bounds it with the body
fields. A missing or blank field is passed on as empty text,
which the rule receives as `LOW-VALUES` and answers with its audited
message, so no field is required here. Each field is bounded by its BMS
length [app/bms/COACTUP.bms], checked by [`AccountUpdateRequest::check`].

acct_credit_limit.description: `ACRDLIM X(15)`: Credit Limit, the amount text `NUMVAL-C` reads.

acct_group_id.description: `AADDGRP X(10)`: Account Group, which no edit checks.

cust_addr_country_cd.description: `ACSCTRY X(3)`: Country, sent back as fetched.

cust_addr_line_2.description: `ACSADL2 X(50)`: Address line 2, which no edit checks.

cust_addr_line_3.description: `ACSCITY X(50)`: City, stored as address line 3.

cust_govt_issued_id.description: `ACSGOVT X(20)`: Government Issued Id, which no edit checks.

cust_ssn_1.description: `ACTSSN1 X(3)`: the first three SSN digits.

cust_ssn_2.description: `ACTSSN2 X(2)`: the fourth and fifth SSN digits.

cust_ssn_3.description: `ACTSSN3 X(4)`: the last four SSN digits.

customer_id.description: `ACSTNUM X(9)`: Customer id, sent back as fetched.

version.description:
The `version` of the `GET /accounts/{id}` response the client edited,
standing for `ACUP-OLD-DETAILS`. A missing or malformed token is
answered in `crate::handlers::accounts` with 400 and no message
(V-COACTUPC-001, E-24) before any COBOL edit, so it has no length rule
here.

AccountUpdateResponse.description:
The 200 answer of `PUT /accounts/{id}`: the records as they now stand and
the information text `COACTUPC` shows, which the SPA shows as a success
notification.

account.description:
The account and customer after the request: rewritten, or as fetched
when nothing changed, with their new token.

message.description:
`messages::CHANGES_COMMITTED_TO_DATABASE` after both rewrites
(P-COACTUPC-015), or
`messages::NO_CHANGE_DETECTED_WITH_RESPECT_TO_VALUES_FETCHED` when the
input equals the fetched values (V-COACTUPC-010).

AccountViewField.description:
A BMS field the errors of `GET /accounts/{id}` name: the `COACTVW` map
[app/cpy-bms/COACTVW.CPY].

AuthDetailField.description:
The BMS field the errors of `GET` and `PUT /authorizations/{id}` name.

`SEND-AUTHVIEW-SCREEN` always puts the cursor on the card number,
`MOVE -1 TO CARDNUML` [app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/cbl/COPAUS1C.cbl:L373-378]
(V-COPAUS1C-001 to V-COPAUS1C-013).

AuthDetailResponse.description:
The `COPAU1A` screen: one pending authorization as
`POPULATE-AUTH-DETAILS` shows it
[app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/cbl/COPAUS1C.cbl:L290-357]
(P-COPAUS1C-005).

account_id.description:
`PA-ACCT-ID`, the account of the summary the detail sits under,
zero-padded.

auth_id.description: The row identity, the `{id}` of this resource.

decline_reason.description:
`AUTHRSNO`: the reason code, `-` and its `WS-DECLINE-REASON-TABLE`
text, such as `4100-INSUFFICNT FUND`, or `9999-ERROR` for a code the
table lacks.

message.description:
The text `COPAUS1C` shows with the record, such as
`Already at the last Authorization...` (V-COPAUS1C-012). Omitted when
it shows none.

next_id.description:
The `auth_id` of the next authorization under the same summary, the
one PF8 shows (P-COPAUS1C-014); `null` when none follows or none was
read.

pa_auth_fraud.description:
`PA-AUTH-FRAUD PIC X(01)`: `F` reported, `R` removed, empty when
never marked. `AUTHFRDO` shows it with the report date for `F` and
`R`, and `-` otherwise.

pa_fraud_rpt_date.description: `PA-FRAUD-RPT-DATE PIC X(08)`, `mm/dd/yy` once fraud was marked.

pa_merchant_catagory_code.description:
`MCCCDO`: `PA-MERCHANT-CATAGORY-CODE PIC X(04)`, spelled as the
copybook spells it.

AuthSummaryField.description:
The BMS field the errors of `GET /authorizations` name.

Every `COPAUS0C` message puts the cursor on the account ID,
`MOVE -1 TO ACCTIDL OF COPAU0AI` (V-COPAUS0C-001 to V-COPAUS0C-015).

auth_id.description:
The row identity: the `{id}` of the detail and the `start_key` of a
page that continues from this line.

AuthSummaryResponse.description:
The `COPAU0A` screen: the header `GATHER-ACCOUNT-DETAILS` fills
[app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/cbl/COPAUS0C.cbl:L750-805] and one page
of authorizations, with the paging contract of `crate::pagination::Page`.

The header carries the fields the COBOL builds its screen text from:
`CNAMEO`, `ADDR001O` and `ADDR002O` are `STRING`s of the customer name and
address fields, which the SPA composes. `ACCSTAT` is not sent: no
`COPAUS0C` statement moves a value to it.

items.description:
The authorizations of the page, newest first (P-COPAUS0C-010). Empty
when the account has no summary or the request browsed nothing.

message.description:
The page-boundary text of a request that browsed nothing,
`You are already at the top of the page...` or
`You are already at the bottom of the page...` (V-COPAUS0C-013,
V-COPAUS0C-014). Omitted otherwise.

next_key.description:
The `start_key` of the next page, read with `direction=forward`; `null`
when no page follows.

pa_approved_auth_cnt.description:
`APPRCNTO`: `PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT PIC S9(04) COMP`; 0 when the
account has no summary segment.

pa_declined_auth_cnt.description:
`DECLCNTO`: `PA-DECLINED-AUTH-CNT PIC S9(04) COMP`; 0 without a
summary.

prev_key.description:
The `start_key` of the previous page, read with `direction=backward`;
`null` when no page precedes it.

BillPaymentField.description:
The BMS fields of `COBIL0A` that the errors of `POST /payments` name in
`fields[].field`: the distinct `BMS field` values of the `V-COBIL00C` rows.

CardListField.description:
The BMS fields a `GET /cards` error names: the `BMS field` values of
the `COCRDLIC` rows. The selector rows V-COCRDLIC-003 and
V-COCRDLIC-004 name none.

CardResponse.description:
A card as `COCRDSL` shows it and `COCRDUP` fetches it: the two keys, the
embossed name, the expiry date and the active status
[app/cbl/COCRDSLC.cbl:L463-484] [app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl:L1088-1117], with
the token `PUT /cards/{id}` echoes back.

The maps show the expiry as `EXPMON` and `EXPYEAR` (and `EXPDAY`,
protected, on `COCRDUP`), cut from the `X(10)` date; the response keeps the
stored text and the SPA cuts it. `CARD-CVV-CD` is not part of the screen
and is never serialized.

account_id.description:
`CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11)` (`ACCTSID`), as its 11 zero-padded digits: the
card's own account, which may differ from the account entered (E-55).

card_embossed_name.description:
`CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50)` (`CRDNAME`), right-trimmed, in its stored
case.

card_expiraion_date.description:
`CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10)`, right-trimmed: `YYYY-MM-DD` in the
fixtures, whose year `(1:4)`, month `(6:2)` and day `(9:2)` are
`EXPYEAR`, `EXPMON` and `EXPDAY`.

version.description:
The card's version token, 16 lower-case hex digits: the keyed digest of
the fields `9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC` compares (AAP 0.3.7). A
`PUT /cards/{id}` sends it back unchanged.

CardSummary.description:
One row of the card list: the `ACCTNOn`, `CRDNUMn` and `CRDSTSn` fields
of the `COCRDLI` map, which `1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT` fills from the
`CARDDAT` record [app/cbl/COCRDLIC.cbl:L684-686] — P-COCRDLIC-017.

The row selector `CRDSELn` has no field: the list's row actions open the
card view and edit routes instead (E-54).

CardUpdateField.description:
The BMS fields a `PUT /cards/{id}` error names: the `BMS field` values
of the `COCRDUPC` rows. V-COCRDUPC-001, the missing version token,
names none.

CardUpdateRequest.description:
The body of `PUT /cards/{id}`: the `COCRDUP` map's input fields as
entered. The card number is the `{id}` path segment.

Each field reaches the rule unchanged, an absent one as empty text, which
`1100-RECEIVE-MAP` reads as a field not entered. `version` is parsed by the
handler, `crate::handlers::cards`: a missing or malformed token is the
no-message 400 of V-COCRDUPC-001 (E-24), answered before any COBOL edit.

embossed_name.description: The embossed name, `CRDNAMEI X(50)`: letters and spaces.

version.description:
The `version` of the card as `GET /cards/{id}` returned it: 16
lower-case hex digits.

CardUpdateResponse.description:
The answer to a successful `PUT /cards/{id}`: the card as it now stands
and the information text `COCRDUPC` shows.

card.description:
The card rewritten, or the card fetched when nothing changed, with its
current token.

message.description:
'Changes committed to database' after a rewrite (P-COCRDUPC-007), or
'No change detected with respect to values fetched.' when nothing
changed (V-COCRDUPC-009).

of the `COCRDSLC` rows.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response: `{code, message, fields?}`.

code.description:
The failure class: an error kind code (`INVALID`, `EMPTY`,
`NOT_FOUND`, `DUPLICATE`, `CONFLICT`, `SIGNON_FAILED`, `UNEXPECTED`),
`UNAUTHENTICATED`, `FORBIDDEN` or `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`. A path no route
serves is `NOT_FOUND`.

The fields the message concerns, in the order the COBOL program places
the cursor on them. Omitted when the message concerns no field.

message.description:
The message text, byte-identical to the audited COBOL message or the
request-written text. Empty for a path that sets no message and whose
escalation names no text.

field.description:
The BMS symbolic field name the COBOL program places the cursor on,
without its suffix (for example `ACCTSID`, `USERID`, `PASSWD`), or the

The answer to PF5: the detail as `UPDATE-AUTH-DETAILS` replaced it and
the text `MARK-AUTH-FRAUD` shows
[app/app-authorization-ims-db2-mq/cbl/COPAUS1C.cbl:L230-266]

The replaced detail: the toggled `PA-AUTH-FRAUD` and the

`AUTH MARKED FRAUD...` when the flag became `F`,

`fields[].field` values of `POST /auth/login` errors, one per distinct
`BMS field` of the `COSGN00C` rows of `docs/parity/validation-audit.md`.

LoginRequest.description:
The body of `POST /auth/login`: the `USERIDI` and `PASSWDI` fields of the
sign-on map, as typed.

Each field is limited to the 8 characters of its `PIC X(8)` map field
[app/cpy-bms/COSGN00.CPY:L72, L78]. An absent field is the empty field the

`PASSWDI`: the password as typed, case unchanged. Sign-on upper-cases
it before it is verified.

user_id.description:
`USERIDI`: the user ID as typed, case unchanged. Sign-on upper-cases
it before the user is read.

The body of a successful `POST /auth/login`: the bearer token and the
`COMMAREA` fields `COSGN00C` sets before its `XCTL`
[app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:L224-240].

`Debug` never shows the token.

expires_at.description: The instant the token expires, RFC 3339.

landing.description:
The SPA route the user type selects: `/admin` for the admin menu
`COADM01C`, `/` for the main menu `COMEN01C`.

token.description: The HS256 bearer token the authenticated endpoints require.

user_id.description:
`CDEMO-USER-ID`: the signed-on user ID, upper-cased as sign-on reads
it, without trailing spaces.

usr_type.description:
`CDEMO-USER-TYPE` [app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:L26-28]: `A` for an
administrator, `U` for a user. For navigation only: the server decides
access from the token's claims, never from this value.

A response that carries only a message, such as the logout text

The message text, byte-identical to the COBOL literal, trailing spaces
included.

items.description:
The rows of the page, in the list's key order. Empty when the page
shows none.

message.description:
The page-boundary text the COBOL program shows with this page, such as

next_key.description:
The `start_key` of the next page, read with `direction=forward`; `null`
when no page follows.

prev_key.description:
The `start_key` of the backward (PF7) request from this page, read

backward request from it answers with the program's no-previous-page
text in `message` (E-54). The other lists give `null` on the first page
read without a `start_key`.
